pretreatments.description: Biological pretreatment: Based on the joint action of the native microbiota composed mainly of Clostridium, Lactobacillus, and Enterobacter, acting as a core microbiome of lignocellulosic biomasses; primarily hydrolyzed xylan to volatile fatty acids (simulated solely as acetic acid) under optimized operating conditions from previous studies.

Enzymatic pretreatment: Based on the action of the commercial enzyme cocktail Cellulase 50XL (293 endoglucanase units/gram of bagasse working in a 50 mM citrate buffer at pH 6); released mainly glucose along with galactose, arabinose, and other sugars representing 69% of the total chemical oxygen demand.

Dilute acid pretreatment: Solubilized all xylan and partially cellulose in 1.8% HCl under soft operating conditions; recovered sugars and eliminated the generation of inhibitors (furfural, hydroxymethylfurfural, and phenols) detected at elevated levels in dilute acid hydrolysates compared to biological and enzymatic hydrolysates.

Steam explosion pretreatment: Solubilized xylan producing a mixture of sugars and acetic acid; performed in a plug flow reactor coupled to a flask tank with instant depressurization; operated at 116°C for low levels and 152°C for high levels; generated low concentrations of furfural and hydroxymethylfurfural.
